## Result and scope

Refs #335

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/335#issuecomment-6867978415 (`ADB991-claude-20261113-b761`)
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026, C15 part-B: the `lem:ex-lattice-trace-weighted-price` row of `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C15/part-B/correspondence.md`, the matching output row of `.../part-B/ledger.md`, and the new evidence directory `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C15/ADB991-claude-20261113-b761/`.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: ADB991 (account holder); Claude (Anthropic), single scheduled session, no subagents. Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

Resolves the nonblocking locator finding of review #112: the part-B records named `scout` as the source of `lem:ex-lattice-trace-weighted-price`. Verified textually at the pin:
- the weighted conclusion is `YM.Trace.Terrace.permute` (`Terrace/Delta.lean` l.45: `e_i•((ρ∘u_i)∘v_i−ρ)→0` in operator norm), packaged by `spend` (l.61; `μ_i=ρ∘u_i→ρ∘U`) and `expenses` (l.63; eventual bound plus the all-vector `∀z>0` form), with helpers `plumage`, `fitV`, `beak` (Delta) and `revise` (`Terrace/Rivers.lean` l.8);
- `scout` (Delta l.31) proves only the unweighted `v_i→f` from `v_i(w_i)→0`; its one caller `springs` (`Terrace/Lease.lean` l.34, call l.45) uses it for `Prosper.alpha` and as hypothesis `hv` of `expenses` (call l.46), whose output fills `Prosper.vote`.

Quantifiers of the manuscript lemma match `permute`/`spend`/`expenses` hypothesis for hypothesis; the manuscript's all-`i` bound on `μ_i=ρu_i` implies Lean's eventual bound. Observations (no change in this scope): O1, the hypothesis `v_i→f` is unused both in `permute`'s proof and in the manuscript proof; O2, the `scout` step corresponds to YM-000033 `prop:trace-prosper-sensor`, not re-reviewed here. No later correction existed to reuse; the unit evidence files already named `plumage`/`spend`/`expenses` and are unchanged. Historical review records are unchanged.
